HOME SCIENCE MARCH — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)

   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
